MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

4. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 56

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

6. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

7. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

8. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 25

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

10. Solve for x: x + 6 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 6
   C. 11
   D. 12

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

12. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

13. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 12

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

17. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 1

18. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

19. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 7

20. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

21. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 17
   C. 25
   D. 27

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

23. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 8

24. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
